content: Coder workspaces have explicit running/stopped/deleted lifecycle; deletion executes terraform destroy and removes both persistent and ephemeral resources. A template can provide ephemeral resources, but a factory-run should explicitly delete its workspace and temporary volumes after publishing evidence rather than assume stop equals cleanup. Official docs: https://coder.com/docs/user-guides/workspace-lifecycle/ and https://coder.com/docs/admin/templates/extending-templates/resource-persistence
